title: Add benchmark-lab mixed workload reporting pipeline v43
author: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Add mixed-workload reporting pipeline (v43) to benchmark-lab. Motivation: unify reporting for mixed CPU/GPU representative workload runs and include profiling baselines for 3 new model variants (q4_0, q4_K_M, fp16) and add aggregated cost/latency charts.

What: - Add new Airflow DAG that ingests runner output, normalizes summaries, computes per-variant percentiles and cost per 1M tokens, and writes to reporting bucket. - Add K8s job templates and Helm values for the representative workload runners. - Wire up nightly CI job and validate CSV/Parquet schema.

Checklist:
- [x] DAG implementation and unit tests
- [x] Runner template and config
- [x] CI pipeline and integration test
- [x] Documentation updates
- [x] Smoke run on staging

Notes: This PR is primarily in the benchmark-lab module but touches infra for reporting and CI. Linear tickets: ENG-1987 (pipeline), ENG-2050 (runner templates). See the benchmark lab README for run instructions: https://github.com/redwood/benchmark-lab#reporting
